title: EmMark: Robust Watermarks for IP Protection of Embedded Quantized Large Language Models
problem: Embedded quantized LLMs on resource-constrained edge devices are vulnerable to IP theft from malicious end-users. Ownership authentication requires robust watermarking mechanisms that preserve model performance.
motivation: Protecting intellectual property of large language models deployed on edge devices requires secure ownership verification to prevent unauthorized replication and misuse.
method: EmMark strategically selects weight parameters to embed watermark signatures into quantized model weights. Ownership is verified by querying the watermarked model and matching extracted signatures. The design ensures robustness against watermark removal and forging attacks while maintaining model fidelity.
key_novelty: Strategic watermark weight parameter selection that simultaneously ensures extraction robustness and preserves model quality in embedded quantized LLMs.
contributions: EmMark framework enabling IP protection through watermarking for embedded LLMs
Strategic weight parameter selection method for robust watermark insertion in quantized models
Demonstration of 100% watermark extraction success while preserving model performance
Empirical evaluation of resilience against watermark removal and forging attacks

metrics.accuracy: 100% watermark extraction success with model performance preservation

limitations: Evaluation limited to OPT and LLaMA-2 families; scalability to larger models and deployment overhead not discussed.
primary_theme: Watermarking for embedded LLM IP protection
